payload.title: Patient-space geometry requires paired position and orientation
payload.statement: DICOM Image Position (Patient) locates the first voxel in patient coordinates; Image Orientation (Patient) provides row and column direction cosines. Use the pair with pixel spacing for a spatial mapping; file names and InstanceNumber alone are not a patient-space transform.

payload.title: Slice thickness and between-slice spacing describe different quantities
payload.statement: In the DICOM Image Plane Module, Slice Thickness describes nominal thickness, while Spacing Between Slices describes center-to-center separation when present. A stack-processing profile must not substitute thickness for measured inter-plane distance without an explicit assumption.
